questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. Rahim’s house is building rapidly.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Rahim’s house is building rapidly.

options.text: Rahim’s house is being built rapidly.
options.html: Rahim’s house is being built rapidly.

options.text: House of Rahim is built rapidly.
options.html: House of Rahim is built rapidly.

options.text: Rahim’s house was built rapidly.
options.html: Rahim’s house was built rapidly.

options.text: House of Rahim has been built rapidly.
options.html: House of Rahim has been built rapidly.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Rahim's house is being built rapidly"

Key Points

  • The original sentence is in the active voice, with the subject "Rahim's house" performing the action of "building".
  • To convert this to the passive voice:
    • the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence
    • the verb is changed to a form of "be" + past participle.
  • Option 2) "House of Rahim is built rapidly." is not correct because it doesn't use the correct passive voice structure.
  • Option 3) "Rahim's house was built rapidly." is in the passive voice, but the tense is incorrect. It indicates that the building of the house has already happened in the past.
  • Option 4) "House of Rahim has been built rapidly." is also in the passive voice, but the tense is incorrect. It indicates that the building of the house happened at an unspecified time in the past, but there is no reference to the present.

Thus, option 1 is the correct answer.

  • In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.

  • The passive format "were + V3" should be used.
  • This is the active and passive voice rule for the past simple tense.
  • Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice. Daddy baked the cookies on the weekend.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice.

Daddy baked the cookies on the weekend.

options.html: Daddy, on the weekend, baked cookies.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: The cookies were baked on the weekend by Daddy.

Key Points

  • In passive voice, the focus is on the action and the recipient of the action rather than the person or thing performing the action.
  • Active Voice Structure: Subject + Verb + Object
    • Example: The chef prepared a delicious meal. (Active)
  • Passive Voice Structure: Object + "to be" + Past Participle of the main verb + By + Subject
    • Example: A delicious meal was prepared by the chef. (Passive)
  • Here, in the given sentence:
    • The subject (Daddy), verb (baked), and object (the cookies).
    • Place the object as the subject: "The cookies."
    • Use the appropriate form of "to be": "were" (past tense).
    • Use the past participle of the main verb: "baked."
    • Include the original subject with "by"

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

questions.question: Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. Close all the windows.
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Close all the windows.

options.text: All the windows be closed.
options.html: All the windows be closed.

options.text: Will you close all the windows?
options.html: Will you close all the windows?

options.text: Let all the windows be closed.
options.html: Let all the windows be closed.

options.text: Can you close all the windows?
options.html: Can you close all the windows?

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Let all the windows be closed.'

Key Points

  • In Active voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
  • In Passive voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
  • The given sentence is an imperative sentence in the active voice.
  • In imperative sentences (which contains an order) where there is no object, 'Let' is used.
  • For Example:-
    • Active Voice - Open the door.
    • Passive Voice - Let the door be opened.
  • An imperative sentence in the passive voice has the following form: Let + object (all the windows) + be + past participle (closed).
  • This is the active and passive voice rule for the present simple tense.
     

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Additional Information

Verbs of passive format have a different set of tenses (*V3 - Past participle or Third form of the Verb) as given below in the table:

TENSE ACTIVE PASSIVE PASSIVE CONVERSION
Present Simple He plays football am/is/are + V3 Football is played by him
Present Continuous He is playing football am/is/are + being +V3 Football is being played by him
Present Perfect He has played football Has/have + been+ V3 Football has been played by him
Present Perfect Continuous He has been playing football Not used and unusual. Not used and unusual
Past Simple He played football Was/were + V3 Football was played by him
Past Continuous He was playing football Was/were + being + V3 Football was being played by him
Past Perfect He had played football Had + been + V3 Football had been played by him
Past Perfect Continuous He had been playing football Not used and unusual Not used and unusual
Future Simple He will play football Will + be + V3 Football will be played by him
Future Continuous He will be playing football Not used and unusual Not used and unusual
Future Perfect He will have played football Will have been + V3 Football will have been played by him
Future Perfect Continuous He will have been playing football Not used and unusual Not used and unusual

 

Hinglish

  • Active voice में , एक वाक्य विषय पर जोर देता है, एक क्रिया करता है।
  • Passive voice में , एक वाक्य वाक्य की क्रिया या वस्तु पर जोर देता है।
  • दिया गया वाक्य active voice में एक imperative sentence है।
  • Imperative sentence में (जिसमें एक आदेश होता है) जहां कोई वस्तु नहीं है, 'Let' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
  • उदाहरण के लिए:-
    • Active Voice - Open the door.
    • Passive Voice - Let the door be opened.
  • Passive voice में एक imperative sentence का निम्न रूप है: Let + object (all the windows) + be + past participle (closed)।
  • यह present simple tense के लिए active and passive voice rule है।
     

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

The fielder at the slip position took a brilliant catch.

options.text: A brilliant catch was being taken by the fielder at the slip position.
options.html: A brilliant catch was being taken by the fielder at the slip position.

options.text: A brilliant catch had been taken by the fielder at the slip position
options.html: A brilliant catch had been taken by the fielder at the slip position

options.text: A brilliant catch has been taken by the fielder at the slip position.
options.html: A brilliant catch has been taken by the fielder at the slip position.

options.text: A brilliant catch was taken by the fielder at the slip position.
options.html: A brilliant catch was taken by the fielder at the slip position.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'A brilliant catch was taken by the fielder at the slip position.'

Key Points

  • The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
  • The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
    • Subject + V2+ Object. (Active Voice)
    • Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
  • Example:
    • Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)
    • They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)
  • The subject of the given sentence is 'The fielder'.​​
  • The object of the given sentence is 'a brilliant catch'. 
  • The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
  • 'took' will be changed into 'was taken'. 
  • Lastly, the preposition 'by' will be added. 
  • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4.
    ​

Correct Sentence: A brilliant catch was taken by the fielder at the slip position.

Hinglish 

  • ​दिया गया वाक्य Active Voice में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे Passive Voice में बदलना है।
  • दिए गए वाक्य की संरचना इस प्रकार है:
    • Subject + V2+ Object. (Active Voice)
    • Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
  • उदाहरण:
    • Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)
    • They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)
  • दिए गए वाक्य का subject ''The fielder'' है।​
  • दिए गए वाक्य का object ''a brilliant catch'' है।
  • Object के स्थान पर Subject रखा जाएगा और Subject के स्थान पर Object रखा जाएगा।
  • 'took' को 'was taken' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
  • अंत में, preposition 'by' जोड़ा जाएगा।
  • इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

questions.question: Select the sentence that is expressed in passive voice.
questions.questionHtml: Select the sentence that is expressed in passive voice.

options.text: I prefer tea to coffee.
options.html: I prefer tea to coffee.

options.text: Children are participating in sand-art competition.
options.html: Children are participating in sand-art competition.

options.text: She sketches beautifully.
options.html: She sketches beautifully.

options.text: The consignment was delivered yesterday.
options.html: The consignment was delivered yesterday.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 4.
 
Key Points
  • Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
  • In this case, "the consignment" (the subject) is receiving the action (delivered).
  • The doer of the action is not mentioned in the sentence, and the focus is on what happened to the consignment.
  • This is a clear example of passive voice because the action is being done to the subject (the consignment), not by it.
  • The sentence "The consignment was delivered yesterday" focuses on the consignment being acted upon, not on who delivered it.
Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.
 
Correct Sentence: "The consignment was delivered yesterday."
 
Additional Information
  • Option 1: "I prefer tea to coffee." – This sentence is in active voice. The subject "I" is performing the action (prefer), and "tea" and "coffee" are objects of the preference.
  • Option 2: "Children are participating in sand-art competition." – This sentence is in active voice. The subject "children" are performing the action (participating). "In sand-art competition" is the location of the action. 
  • Option 3: "She sketches beautifully." – This sentence is in active voice. The subject "she" is performing the action (sketches).

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Taru was fined by a traffic policeman for jumping the red light'.

Key Points 

  • The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
  • The structure of the given sentence as follows:
    • Subject + V2+ Object. (Active Voice)
    • Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
  • Example:
    • Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)
    • They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)
  • The subject of the given sentence is 'A traffic policeman'.​​
  • The object of the given sentence is 'Taru'. 
  • The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
  • And 'fined' will be changed into 'was fined'. 
  • Lastly, the 'by' preposition will be added. 
  • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4.
    ​

Correct Sentence: Taru was fined by a traffic policeman for jumping the red light.

Hinglish

  • ​दिया गया वाक्य Active Voice में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे Passive Voice में बदलना है।
  • दिए गए वाक्य की संरचना इस प्रकार है:
    • Subject + V2+ Object. (Active Voice)
    • Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
  • उदाहरण:
    • Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)
    • They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)
  • दिए गए वाक्य का विषय 'A traffic policeman' है।​
  • दिए गए वाक्य का उद्देश्य 'Taru' है।
  • Object के स्थान पर Subject रखा जाएगा और Subject के स्थान पर Object रखा जाएगा।
  • और 'fined' को 'was fined' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
  • अंत में, 'by' preposition जोड़ा जाएगा।
  • इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

Additional Information 

  • Verbs of passive format have a different set of tenses (*V3 - Past participle or Third form of the Verb) as given below in the table:
TENSE ACTIVE PASSIVE PASSIVE CONVERSION
Present Simple He plays football. am/is/are + V3 Football is played by him.
Present Continuous He is/am/are playing football. am/is/are + being +V3 Football is being played by him.
Present Perfect He has played football. Has/have + been+ V3 Football has been played by him.
Present Perfect Continuous He has been playing football. Not used and unusual. Not used and unusual.
Past Simple He played football. Was/were + V3 Football was played by him.
Past Continuous He was playing football. Was/were + being + V3 Football was being played by him.
Past Perfect He had played football. Had + been + V3 Football had been played by him.
Past Perfect Continuous He had been playing football. Not used and unusual Not used and unusual.
Future Simple He will play football. Will + be + V3 Football will be played by him.
Future Continuous He will be playing football. Not used and unusual Not used and unusual.
Future Perfect He will have played football. Will have been + V3 Football will have been played by him.
Future Perfect Continuous He will have been playing football. Not used and unusual Not used and unusual.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'The crop was being harvested by the villagers with great enthusiasm.'.

Key Points

  • We need to follow these instructions while changing the voice of an assertive sentence.
    • Find the subject and object of the sentence and exchange their places; make changes in their cases as well if subject and object are pronouns.
    • Use preposition by before agent. (the villagers)
    • Use helping verb in passive form according to the tense of active form. (Past continuous - was/were + being)
    • Always use the third form of the main verb in passive form.
    • At last line up the remaining part.
      ​

Following these steps, we finally get- The crop was being harvested by the villagers with great enthusiasm.

Additional Information

  • Assertive sentence is the type of sentence that declares or asserts a statement, feeling, opinion, incident, event, history, or anything.
  • An assertive sentence ends with a full stop (.).
  • Assertive sentences can be either affirmative or negative.
    • E.g. Indian cricket team played well in the last match.

Key Points
  • Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. They cancelled the meeting due to bad weather.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: The meeting was cancelled due to bad weather.

Key Points

  • In an active voice sentence, the subject performs the action.
  • Active Voice Structure: Subject + Verb + Object
    • Example: The chef prepared a delicious meal.
  • In a passive voice sentence, the subject receives the action.
  • Passive Voice Structure: Object + Be verb + V3 + Subject
    • Example: A delicious meal was prepared by the chef.
  • So, here in the passive voice, the subject "They" from the active voice can be included using "by them" in the passive voice.
  • The passive construction shifts the focus from the doer (They) to the action (cancelling the meeting).

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.
